Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Stagiar
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Signicat is a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence.
Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world.
 About The Role
 We are looking for a Java/Kotlin Engineer to join the team behind Signicat’s MobileID and Digital Identity Wallet solutions. You will help build and scale secure, reliable services that support authentication, identity verification, payment confirmations and the issuing of digital credentials across Europe.
You’ll work closely with other engineering teams to design and develop the core services and interfaces that power our products. The team takes ownership of the solutions it builds, from development through to running them in production, and uses modern, AI-assisted ways of working to solve problems efficiently and deliver high-quality results.
 What Will You Work On
Design, build and maintain the microservices at the core of the Signicat’s MobileID and Digital Identity Wallet solutions.
Own your services end to end, from code and tests through deployment, monitoring and how they actually behave in production.
Work on the delivery platform alongside the rest of the team.
Strengthen the security of the solution: threat modelling, keeping current with standards, and the authentication protocols and key handling the whole product rests on.
Take part in architecture decisions and technical discussions, within the team and across the client and service teams.
 Core Technologies You Will Get To Work With
Languages: Java, Kotlin
Frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot, Ktor
Cloud platforms: GCP (production SaaS), AWS (test automation)
Containers and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
Delivery: ArgoCD (GitOps), GitLab CI, Jenkins
Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform
APIs: RESTful API development in Java and Kotlin (Spring, Ktor)
Databases: MySQL, Oracle
Operating systems: Linux.
 What We Expect
2+ years of experience with Java and/or Kotlin.
Comfortable working with Spring or a comparable JVM framework, and experienced in designing REST APIs used by other teams.
Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS or Google).
Real experience running services on Kubernetes (not only handing over a Dockerfile to someone else).
Hands-on knowledge of relational databases, ideally MySQL (exposure to PostgreSQL or other relational databases is also relevant).
A security instinct: you think about what an attacker would do with the API you just designed.
Demonstrated experience using AI tools and integrating them into everyday work.
Strong English proficiency, both written and spoken.
 Bonus Points For
Experience with Helm, ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling.
Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code.
OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect in production, not just in theory.
Cryptography, key management or HSMs.
Mobile authentication, biometrics or device attestation.
Regulated environments such as PSD2 and strong customer authentication, or eIDAS.
 What we offer
Fully remote role in Portugal - for candidates based in Portugal, this role is fully remote, giving you the flexibility to work from wherever you are.
Hybrid work style in Romania - for candidates based in Romania, we offer a hybrid working model, with an expectation to work from our Bucharest office 3 days per week.
Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market.
Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences.
Work-life balance - enjoy extra paid days off annually, and we will celebrate your work anniversaries with additional days off to recognise and reward your milestones.
Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app.
Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, defined career paths and internal mentorship opportunities.
Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning.
Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any European country.
Give back to the community - option to use 16 hours of paid volunteer time each year to support a charity or cause you are passionate about.
Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together.
Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss.
 We will discuss salary expectations during the hiring process to ensure our offer reflects your experience and qualifications.
 We're a dynamic community of passionate professionals dedicated to digital identity solutions.
Since our founding, we have grown and evolved through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, and continuous innovations.
This makes Signicat an exciting and ever-changing environment to be a part of!
